name: Harbor AI Fund
description: Holds companies that build machine learning products. The fund follows Python model work, scikit-learn style classical models, and teams that train predictive systems.

name: Northwind Technology Fund
description: Holds technology companies that sell software and cloud tools. The fund follows programming teams, AWS platforms, and product engineering.

name: Lumen Software Fund
description: Holds software companies that ship product interfaces. The fund follows React applications, CSS layout, and teams that design web screens.

name: Fieldnote Healthcare Fund
description: Holds healthcare companies and clinical research firms. The fund follows patient data, healthcare language tools, and NLP work on medical notes.

name: Cedar Data Fund
description: Holds companies that run data platforms. The fund follows SQL warehouses, Python pipelines, and Spark processing for large tables.

name: Northwind Cloud Fund
description: Holds cloud and infrastructure companies. The fund follows AWS hosting, Docker packaging, and Kubernetes operations.

name: Harbor Energy Fund
description: Holds companies that produce oil, gas, and electric power. The fund follows energy prices and utility demand, not software or research labs.

name: Sample Broad Market Fund
description: Holds a wide mix of public companies across many industries. It does not lean on one field.

name: Lumen Consumer Fund
description: Holds shops, brands, and consumer apps. The fund follows retail demand and design work in Figma, not model training.

name: Cedar Finance Fund
description: Holds banks, insurers, and payment firms. The fund follows lending, markets, and spreadsheet reporting.

name: Harbor Security Fund
description: Holds cybersecurity companies. The fund follows Linux hardening, cloud protection, and security software.

name: Fieldnote Analytics Fund
description: Holds companies that sell reporting and analytics tools. The fund follows Pandas tables, SQL metrics, and Tableau dashboards.
